post.meaning: Riches ruin the foolish, but not those who seek the far shore; by craving for wealth the fool ruins himself as he would ruin others.
post.caption:
Hananti bhogā dummedhaṁ, no ca pāragavesino;
Bhogataṇhāya dummedho, hanti aññeva attanaṁ.

धन मूर्ख को नष्ट करता है, पर उसे नहीं जो पार की खोज में है; धन की तृष्णा से मूर्ख स्वयं को वैसे ही नष्ट करता है जैसे दूसरों को।

Riches ruin the foolish, but not those who seek the far shore; by craving for wealth the fool ruins himself as he would ruin others.

— Dhammapada, Verse 355

reel.meaning: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as for the Lord and not for people.
reel.caption:
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

जो कुछ तुम करते हो, तन-मन से करो, यह समझकर कि मनुष्यों के लिए नहीं, पर प्रभु के लिए करते हो।

Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as for the Lord and not for people.

— Colossians (KJV), 3:23
